description: This file defines classes and functions related to OAuth2 security schemes in FastAPI, including dependency classes for handling OAuth2 password flow, token bearer authentication, OAuth2 code flow, and scope management.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
classes.description: Dependency class to parse OAuth2 password flow form data, extracting fields like username, password, scope, client_id, and client_secret.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestFormStrict
classes.description: Subclass of OAuth2PasswordRequestForm that enforces the 'grant_type' field to be 'password' as per OAuth2 spec.

classes.name: OAuth2
classes.description: Base class for OAuth2 security schemes, handling the OpenAPI model and request authentication.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordBearer
classes.description: OAuth2 flow class for bearer token authentication, expecting a token obtained via password flow.

classes.name: OAuth2AuthorizationCodeBearer
classes.description: OAuth2 flow class for bearer token obtained via OAuth2 authorization code flow.

classes.name: SecurityScopes
classes.description: Helper class to aggregate OAuth2 scopes required by multiple dependencies and path operations.

methods.name: HTTPException make_not_authenticated_error(self)
methods.description: Creates an HTTP 401 error indicating the user is not authenticated.

methods.name: Optional[str] __call__(self, request: Request)
methods.description: Asynchronous method to extract the authorization token from the incoming HTTP request headers.
